correctness.rationale: The main source proves genus 9 and identifies eight simple Artin–Schreier poles; an exact polynomial identity verifies birational equivalence of its models. Eight ramified fibers are counted correctly over each F_(2^n). Two exhaustive computations over fully checked field models agree at n=1..12. Newton identities determine c0..c9 from n<=9, and the Weil functional equation determines c10..c18. Direct exact multiplication checks the five-factor numerator and L(1)=1024. Exact irreducibility over Q of the degree-4 and degree-8 factors together with Tate theory yields the dimensions and multiplicities. Both embedded scripts were executed successfully.

value.rationale: For a canonical explicitly presented genus-nine F2 representative in a recent Nakajima-extremal family, the L-polynomial is a central arithmetic invariant. It controls all extension-field point counts and all Frobenius eigenvalues, determines #Jac(F2)=1024, and decomposes the Jacobian into simple isogeny pieces of dimensions 1,1,1,2,4; these are motivated structural quantities not arbitrary finite cutoffs. The finite exhaustive computation gives a complete infinite-degree result via Weil symmetry.
